newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's upgrades Guangdong Enterprises' rating.
newsitem.headline: Moody's upgrades Guangdong Enterprises' rating.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Friday that it had upgraded the senior unsecured rating of Hong Kong-based Guangdong Enterprises (Holding) Ltd (GDE) to Baa3 from Ba1.

The rating reflected the Guangdong provincial government's decision to issue a letter of support for GDE pledging it would continue to provide it with financial and other necessary backing, Moody's said.
The government also publicly confirmed that GDE was entitled to choose investment projects offering commercial rates of return, Moody's said.

The rating agency said this was an important consideration in light of the close relations between GDE and the provincial government and the integral role played by GDE in the government's 20-year development plan.
